fields.statement: Verifier at 7f7fabf17 (attempt 2): go test -trimpath -count=1 ./tools/release/... -run TestNotes PASS; go vet and gofmt clean on tools/release. The test builds a fixture log (bug, milestone-served, breaking-marked, severe-marked and two kind=record landings, plus one before the tag) and compares Notes() with testdata/notes.golden: breaking changes with reasons and detected differences first, the milestone group with its statement, other changes, bug fixes with the severe one flagged; record change sets left out, output deterministic. Attempt 1's finding is fixed: ReadHistory now reads the open body's kind and Notes skips kind=record (still calling out a breaking mark on one). A scratch build of tools/release run as `check` in this checkout drafted v0.2.0 notes since v0.1.0 in 53 lines, grouped by milestone with bug fixes listed, and no 'Record agent actor' or 'apply' lines.
